rules.title: rustfmt and clippy
rules.text: Run cargo fmt and cargo clippy and treat warnings as errors in CI.

rules.title: Result over panic
rules.text: Return Result and propagate with ?; avoid unwrap and expect outside tests.

rules.title: thiserror and anyhow
rules.text: Use thiserror for library errors and anyhow for application errors.

rules.title: Borrow before cloning
rules.text: Prefer borrowing over cloning; clone only when ownership is needed.

rules.title: Justify unsafe
rules.text: Avoid unsafe; when required, keep it minimal and document its safety invariants.

rules.title: Let chains
rules.text: Prefer let chains over nested if let where the edition supports them.

rules.title: expect over allow
rules.text: If a Clippy lint must be silenced, use #[expect] over #[allow] so stale suppressions get flagged.

rules.title: Avoid unwrap and panic
rules.text: Avoid unwrap, expect, panic! and unreachable! in library code. Encode the invariant in types or return an error.

rules.title: Exhaustive match
rules.text: Prefer exhaustive match without a wildcard arm, so new enum variants force a decision.

rules.title: SAFETY comments
rules.text: Give every unsafe block a SAFETY comment stating the invariants it relies on.

rules.title: Debug builds while developing
rules.text: Develop with debug builds and use --release only for performance work.

rules.title: cargo update --precise
rules.text: Change lockfile entries with cargo update --precise instead of updating every dependency.

rules.title: Clippy with warnings denied
rules.text: Run cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets with warnings denied in CI.

rules.title: Narrow visibility
rules.text: Default to private items and use pub(crate) unless another crate needs the item.

rules.title: Constructor names
rules.text: Name functions that return Self as constructors: new, new_* or from_*.

rules.title: Intra-doc links
rules.text: Link types in doc comments with intra-doc links such as [`TypeName`].

rules.title: Minimal annotations
rules.text: Annotate types only where inference needs help, and keep annotations short with _ placeholders.
